title: Former UNP councillor remanded over alleged Rs. 160 mn fraud
summary:
A former UNP Urban Councillor from Horana has been remanded until 21 July over an alleged Rs. 160 million financial fraud involving six textile businessmen in Pettah.



Police allege the suspect obtained money by issuing dishonoured cheques, causing losses of nearly Rs. 160 million.

title: Man injured in Dehiwala cemetery shooting
summary:
A man has been hospitalised after being injured in a shooting inside the Dehiwala–Mount Lavinia public cemetery, police said.



According to police, two suspects who arrived on a motorcycle entered the cemetery, opened fire at the victim and fled the scene.

title: Dengue cases in Sri Lanka surpass 75,000
summary: The National Dengue Control Unit (NDCU) says 75,321 dengue cases have been reported in Sri Lanka so far this year, with 843 new infections recorded on 18 July.

title: SLS certification mandatory for sanitary towels from October
summary: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) has announced that all locally manufactured single-use sanitary towels sold in Sri Lanka must carry the Sri Lanka Standards Institution (SLSI) Product Certification Mark from 8 October 2026.

title: IRD warns willful tax defaulters face fines and jail
summary: The Inland Revenue Department (IRD) says it will initiate criminal proceedings against individuals and entities that willfully fail to meet their tax obligations under the Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act, No. 11 of 2026.
